thread:
Maria: Quick proposal: add a 'soft-unbind' marker to pin metadata so we can ramp traffic without evicting caches immediately.
Evan: high level invariants?
Maria: pinned clients keep old affinity; new resolvers follow ramp rules. rollback must be trivial.
Sofia: how does this differ from TTL?
Maria: TTL forces eviction at expiry. soft-unbind keeps the pin but marks a grace window and a ramp_strategy.
Ben: telemetry needed per-variant+tenant: error_rate, p95, cache_hits. add fields to metadata so dashboards can auto-configure.
Kai: ramping idea: deterministic hash + percent buckets per-namespace. keep parsing simple.
Evan: shared pools -> explicit fallback_order required in metadata so runtime knows alternatives.
Sofia: fallback_order example: ["pinned","namespace_preferred","compatible","global_fallback"]. runtime must annotate chosen reason.
Maria: probe contract: probe=true -> returns {variant_id, route_reason, health, latency_estimate}. lightweight.
Ben: example metadata snippet to include in PR:
soft_unbind_until: "1759997921"
ramp_strategy: "hash_percent:ns:10->50->100"
fallback_order: ["pinned","namespace_preferred","compatible","global_fallback"]
enforce_soft_unbind: "false"
canary_namespaces: ["payments","search"]
probe_endpoint: "/v1/pin_probe"
Kai: migration note: existing pins get enforce_soft_unbind=false and null soft_unbind_until. migration script should be non-destructive.
Evan: client docs need resolver opt-in and trace changes for fallback reasons.
Ben: I'll draft dashboards and alerts (error_rate >1% or p95 regression >20%).
Maria: Action items: Maria -> PR + migration; Ben -> telemetry; Kai -> parser/controller; Evan -> resolver docs; Sofia -> fallback spec. Aim: staging EOW, prod next week if green.
DeployBot: deploybot: model-routing-controller v2.13 deployed to staging at 1759994300 :rocket:
